criteria.statement: Bahia has a real internal dns: backend for the LAN resolver path: the dnsmasq_agent backend drives an authoritative dnsmasq include on the resolver host through the bahia.dnsagent.v1 ContextVM wire contract.

A control-plane operation creates and updates a managed internal record: the projected Astillero record (astillero.sharegap.net -> 192.168.40.104) converges onto the remote resolver through the periodic DNS reconcile path, and record updates replace the managed include content.
tests: internal/adapters/dns/dnsmasq_agent_e2e_test.go: TestDnsmasqAgentBackendPreservesForeignIncludeFiles (update path: second sync with changed value)

criteria.statement: dig answers are traceable to Bahia state: the include file written on the agent side is byte-exactly the render of Bahia's desired record set, ListRecords round-trips it, and dns-agent/health reports the applied serial.
tests: OPERATOR: dig @192.168.40.1 astillero.sharegap.net per docs/runbooks/core01-dnsmasq-agent.md section 7

criteria.statement: Existing manually managed records on the resolver are preserved: foreign include files (sharegap-splitdns.conf) are byte-identical across syncs, and failed reloads roll the Bahia include back without corrupting resolver state.
tests: OPERATOR: before/after dig of all manual names per docs/runbooks/core01-dnsmasq-agent.md section 5

criteria.statement: The agent fails closed: zones outside the allowlist are rejected with a clear error that surfaces through the Bahia-side backend, and no include file is created for them.
